desc: Derive the binomial expansion formula: answer = Σ_{j=0}^{K} C(K,j)(-1)^j Σ_{r=1}^{N} S_r^{K-j} · Q_j(r-1), where Q_j(t) = Σ_{i=0}^{t} S_i^j (with S_0 = 0).

Implement the full Python solution: fast I/O with sys.stdin.buffer.read; binomial coefficients C(K,j) mod 998244353; single pass r=1..N maintaining S and P[j] (init P[0]=1); incremental powers of S; contribution with (-1)^j sign; update P; print answer mod p.
Verify logic against sample 1 (expect 75) mentally and confirm O(NK) ≈ 2.2×10^6 operations fits constraints.
